data.title: Heads Up, Pilots: Join the Content Creator Program!
data.meta_title: Heads Up, Pilots: Join the Content Creator Program!
data.content:
The Wild Ten needs more Pilots like you to join the fight. If you stream or make videos for War Robots: Frontiers, then you need to join the next evolution of the MY.GAMES Content Creator Program!

When you become a War Robots: Frontiers Content Creator, you’ll get access to exclusive events and rewards. We’ll even be making revenue sharing available to creators at a later date.

Create engaging content, share your passion, and start earning. Videos, streams, or social posts — the more you make, the more rewards you can unlock!

As a War Robots: Frontiers Content Creator, you’ll gain access to:

  • Creator Dashboard: Automatically track any and all of your videos and streams about War Robots: Frontiers to earn exclusive rewards.
  • Rewards: Receive in-game content like cosmetics and currency. This allows you to stay on top of the latest content and offer the most interesting and up-to-date gameplay to your audiences.
  • Giveaways: Host giveaways for your audience to reward them with in-game content.
  • Promotions: Your channels, videos, and streams have the chance to be featured on the official War Robots: Frontiers website and social channels.
  • Promotional Assets: The War Robots: Frontiers team will provide you with access to a library of assets you can use in your streams and videos.
  • Connect with the Team: The War Robots: Frontiers team will provide you with news, information, and help organize the promotion of your channels and activities.

Join in three easy steps, and start earning rewards for making the content you love!

Download War Robots: Frontiers for free today:

PlayStation®5│PlayStation®4│ Xbox Series X|S │Xbox One

Steam │ MY.GAMES Launcher

Stay tuned to our official X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok channels, and join the War Robots: Frontiers subreddit and Discord for all the latest news and updates.
